title.narrative: Facilitate a participatory developed community led accountability model building on existing system

description.narrative: This project is to facilitate the development of a community-led accountability model that will build on existing structures and systems. It will entail the development of ToT module on innovation using Design Thinking Approach. The aim is to support the design of community led accountability model in Beni, Kindu and Kasongo and to support documentation and learning. this project is being carried out to solve the problem of weak/poor accountability to community, to reduce bottom up accountability, weak participation in the feedback and complaint mechanisms by the communities, less demand for accountability of actors and donors to community, to reduce the use of strategies and calls for proposals developed without much participation of the community, and less existence of flexible funds for community capacity strengthening and for responding to priority needs of the communities. the actors involved will be Community leaders, CBO representatives, Government/Officials and, Academics/scientists where applicable. the expected learning is that there will be sustainable and replicable functional community led accountability model, values and local knowledge will be used as resources, and there will be clarity of roles and responsibilities described by the model. at the end of the project, the expected success will be that there will be improved donors and others actors accountability to the community, improved service to the community/beneficiaries and an effective top down accountability.
